title: EquiSteer: Training-Free Diffusion Debiasing
summary: EquiSteer introduces an inference-time cross-attention steering framework that mitigates demographic bias in text-to-image diffusion models by up to 87% without requiring model retraining.
research_notes:
Select the target text-to-image diffusion backbone, such as Stable Diffusion or SANA, and define the demographic attributes targeted for debiasing.

Precompute attribute steering vectors using paired contrastive text prompts reflecting the chosen demographic dimensions.

Integrate the prompt-aware gating mechanism into the model's cross-attention layers during the reverse diffusion inference sampling process.

Generate images using standard prompts; the gate leaves explicit attribute prompts intact while injecting steering vectors into neutral prompts.

Use targeted contrastive pairs rather than broad semantic descriptions when calculating steering vectors to prevent diluting primary text-image alignment.

Rely on prompt-aware gating to bypass intervention when input prompts already contain explicit attribute descriptors, avoiding conflicting activation adjustments.

Validate parity gap reductions on domain-specific neutral role prompts before production deployment across different diffusion backbones.
